answer: Beacon-reef tide-table bond: each identity locks 70, registers a reef-anchored orchard plot, and files a key-signed reading from its reef gauge. Each epoch the beacon publishes a public tide table for auditors to recheck readings. Rented gauges fail: a reading off by over 3%, a reused serial, or a copied reading burns it. First 36, k-th 36+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 36 once and keep their orchard plot.
